title: Find the display name of the user who has the highest total favorite count
question: Find the display name of the user who has the highest total favorite count among all users who are either teenagers (age 13–18) or elders (age > 65), and whose posts received at least one bounty of 50 in 2011.

prediction.sql: SELECT T1."XCL_055" FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033" WHERE (T1."XCL_064" BETWEEN 13 AND 18 OR T1."XCL_064" > 65) AND T2."XCL_026" IN (SELECT T3."XCL_067" FROM votes AS T3 WHERE T3."XCL_071" = 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_069") = '2011') GROUP BY T1."XCL_052" ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_039") DESC LIMIT 1

semantic_memory.interpretation_policy: Assignments are conditional on the proposed role vocabulary; feasibility is not independent validation of business labels. Use original historical SQL and physical observations to compare competing interpretations.

eligibility.predicate: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM votes WHERE votes.XCL_067 = posts.XCL_026 AND votes.XCL_071 = 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', votes.XCL_069) = '2011')

measures.multiplicity_argument: each post contributes its favorite_count once per user

arguments.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
WHERE (T1."XCL_064" BETWEEN 13 AND 18 OR T1."XCL_064" > 65)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM votes AS T3
    WHERE T3."XCL_067" = T2."XCL_026"
      AND T3."XCL_071" = 50
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_069") = '2011'
  )
GROUP BY T1."XCL_052"
ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_039") DESC
LIMIT 1

INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
